PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
SRI LANKA ARCHITECTS’ SERVICE MINUTE

THE following revisions are made to the Sri Lanka Architects’ Service Minute published in the Gazette Extraordinary ofthe Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 1877/28 dated 28.08.2014 and revised by the Gazette Extraordinaryof the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 1882/18 dated 01.10.2014 and No. 1952/20 dated 02.02.2016 andthe other matters and conditions of the said service minute shall remain unchanged.
01. Effective date : This service minute shall be effective from 01.01.2006.
20. Interim period and promotions

20.1 The interim period shall be effective from 01.01.2006 to 30.06.2012. The promotions of the officers whosatisfy the following qualifications and requirements within the interim period shall be made in the followingmanner.
20.1.1 Promotion to Grade II of the service

1. An officer who has joined the service before 01.01.2006 and who has been absorbed into Grade IIIshall be promoted to Grade II within the interim period to be effective from the date on which hesatisfies all the qualifications and requirements for promotion to Grade I, Class I from Grade II,Class II of the service as indicated in Sri Lanka Architects’ Service Minute published in the GazetteExtraordinary No. 888/2 dated 12.09.1995 and the relevant revisions.

II. The recommendations on promotion to Grade II of the service as mentioned above shall be submittedto the Public Service Commission by the Secretary of the Ministry in charge of the subject ofPublic Administration.
20.1.2 Promotion to Grade I of the service.

I. If the officers, who have joined the service before 01.01.2016 and absorbed into Grade II orpromoted to Grade II, satisfy the following qualifications and requirements in each and every waywithin the interim period, they shall be promoted to Grade I from the date of satisfying the same.

II. The recommendations on promotion to Grade I of the service as mentioned above shall be submittedto the Public Service Commission by the Secretary of the Ministry in charge of the subject ofPublic Administration.
20.1.3 Promotion to Special Grade of the service

1. If the officers, who have joined the service before 01.01.2006 and absorbed into Grade I or promoted toGrade I, satisfy the following qualifications and requirements in each and every way within the interimperiod, they shall be promoted to Special Grade as indicated in 10.3.1.1 for the vacancies in SpecialGrade.
i. Shall have earned a Postgraduate Degree in Architecture

ii. Shall have completed an active and satisfactory service period of five (05) years in Grade One ofExecutive Service Category and shall have earned the five salary increments after promoting intoGrade One.

iii. Shall have completed an active period of service not less than 18 years in the Executive Graderelated to the service category/posts on which the officer is qualified to be promoted as at the datequalified for the promotion.
iv. Shall have proved a satisfactory or higher level of annual performance in the 05 years immediatelypreceding the date of becoming qualified for the promotion.
v. Shall have continuously maintained the full professional qualifications.
vi. Shall have completed a satisfactory period of service and have not been subjected to a disciplinarypunishment within the 05 years immediately preceding to the date of qualifying for promotion.
2. “Other” should be revised as No. 21 due to the inclusion of interim provisions under No. 20.
3. Salary in arrears should not be paid for promotions which are made from 01.01.2006 to 05.04.2013 onthe revision of the effective date of the service minute.
On the order of Public Service Commission,
H. M. GAMINI SENEVIRATHNE,Secretary,Public Service Commission.
